terms.gloss: frangipani (the botanical name of the genus)
terms.comment: The botanists’ name of the genus, labelled modern, after the French botanist Charles Plumier; the common trees of Asian gardens and temples are Plumeria rubra and Plumeria obtusa. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini) has a name for it.

phrases.latin: Flōs plumeriae dē arbore cecidit; tibi post aurem pōnam.
phrases.english: A frangipani flower has fallen from the tree; I’ll put it behind your ear.
